ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious PFX File Creation
ruleDefinitions.description: A general detection for processes creating PFX files. This could be an indicator of an adversary exporting a local certificate to a PFX file.

sequences.query: file_path = RGX("\\\.pfx$") AND  NOT ((file_path = RGX(".*\\\\Templates\\\\Windows\\\\Windows\\_TemporaryKey\\\.pfx.*") AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\\CMake\\\\.*")))
